description: US-Iran initial deal (2026-06-14) to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz: a Memorandum of Understanding is to be signed in Switzerland on 2026-06-19, followed by a 60-day ceasefire window for a more expansive agreement (lift the naval blockade, dismantle Iran's nuclear program, remove enriched uranium). Trump-administration officials put ~80% odds on signing. This is the OPPOSITE-SIGN reversal of cat_20260228_hormuz_closure: bearish for oil/LNG/tankers (the war premium unwinds) and risk-on for the broad market (geopolitical risk premium fades, lower energy costs / lower inflation impulse). Friday reaction: Brent -4.7% to $83.25, WTI -5.1% to $80.53 (lowest since 2026-03-10); oil ~-6% on the week but still +20% above pre-conflict levels. Normalization is gradual even after signing — Hormuz mine-clearing, restart of idled production, facility repairs (CBA: flows only need to reach 60-70% of pre-war levels to restore oversupply expectations).
